clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post, Pixel hires Horde adventurers to gather satyr horns for Ratchet. The traveling goblin sees a chance to trade them in the port town.

Pixel, a traveling goblin, sees a chance to profit while resting at Splintertree Post. Satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet, and Pixel wants them for the journey back south to the port town. Rather than risk facing the corrupted creatures, Pixel hires passing adventurers to bring back sixteen intact horns.

Demonic satyrs haunt scattered, fel-tainted ruins across Ashenvale, remnants of their betrayal during the ancient sundering. Hunters can search their strongholds at Night Run, the fortified camp of Satyrnaar, and the shadowed groves of Xavian. Horns gathered from any of these places are the trophies Pixel seeks for Ratchet's merchant wharves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.
After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... But you look like you might be!
Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, friend. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are perfect, friend! Thanks for helping me out!
Oh, and this is for your time...
